task.description:
Hard gate — validate CODE-DESIGNER output for WF02-obp-ddl-20260817 before implementation.

Design files to validate:
- src/design/obp-01-outbox-depth-cap.md
- src/design/obp-02-ingress-refusal.md
- src/design/obp-03-outbox-overflow.md
- src/design/ddl-03-phased-ddl-generation.md

Requirements covered: OBP-01, OBP-02, OBP-03, DDL-03 (from docs/requirements.yaml).

For each design file, verify:
1. Every acceptance criterion from the corresponding requirement is covered by a named data structure, function signature, or migration — no AC is left unaddressed.
2. No implementation code is present (pseudocode and interfaces only).
3. The design is complete enough for BACKEND-DEV to implement without ambiguity.
4. No contradictions between the four designs (especially OBP-01 depth interface used by OBP-02 and OBP-03).
5. The three open questions flagged by CODE-DESIGNER (plat_outbox vs effects_outbox naming, tenant extraction mechanism, identifier allow-list) are either resolved in the design or explicitly out-of-scope with a clear rationale.

Return PASS only if all 5 checks pass for all 4 designs.
Return FAIL with specific gaps if any check fails.

Write result into the handoff file when done.

result.summary: 4 of 5 design artefacts failed lint_design_artefact.py (BLOCKER/MAJOR). BLOCKER: migration_number 1165 in templates/specs/obp-01-plat-outbox-gate-depth-ts.migration.yaml collides with migrations/1165_vld04_definition_semantic_verdict.sql (Y111). MAJOR E050: obp-01, obp-02, ddl-03 each contain a fenced code block exceeding 40 lines. MAJOR Y132 x12: migration YAML test_cases missing requirement_ref, act, assertions. obp-03 passes lint. Coverage and cross-design consistency are good. Three open questions are flagged with proposed defaults but not formally resolved.

issues.description: migration_number 1165 collides with existing migrations/1165_vld04_definition_semantic_verdict.sql. CODE-DESIGNER must choose an unused migration number before BACKEND-DEV proceeds.
Fenced code block at line 71 exceeds 40 lines. Design should sketch signatures, not implement. Split or trim the DepthCache/DepthEntry struct block.
Fenced code block at line 70 exceeds 40 lines. Split the outbox_cap.zig public interface block into smaller signature-only excerpts.
Fenced code block at line 75 exceeds 40 lines. Split the ddl_generate.zig type declarations block.
test_cases[0..3] each missing required fields: requirement_ref, act, assertions. All 4 test case entries must be completed.

Three open questions have proposed defaults but are not formally resolved or declared out-of-scope with rationale. (1) effects_outbox vs plat_outbox naming (OBP-01 OQ1): design assumes they are the same; REQ-ANALYST must confirm before countPending is implemented. (2) Tenant extraction mechanism (OBP-02 OQ1): design defers to ratelimit.zig pattern; BACKEND-DEV must confirm exact field/function. (3) Identifier allow-list for generatePhases (DDL-03 OQ1): design proposes [a-z0-9_]; REQ-ANALYST must confirm. These must be resolved or explicitly declared out-of-scope before BACKEND-DEV starts.

result.next_action: Route back to CODE-DESIGNER for rework: fix migration_number collision (BLOCKER), trim E050 code blocks (MAJOR), complete test_case fields (MAJOR), resolve or formally close the three open questions.
